title: Aralo interchange document (format v0)
description: One file holding a library, or part of one: what `aralo export` writes as JSON or YAML and what `aralo import` reads back. It is not the library format; a library is a folder of files (docs/format/library.md). A snippet here carries its group as a path, because there are no folders in one file. See docs/format/import.md.
$comment: Mirrors `Document` and `SnippetRecord` in crates/aralo-import/src/document.rs and record.rs. When the two disagree, the Rust code wins; please report it. The reader also accepts a bare array of snippets, which is what a hand-written file or another tool's export usually is; this schema describes the document Aralo writes.

format.description: The format version, the same integer as `aralo.yaml`. A file with no `format` key is read as a document from somewhere else: its bodies go through the macro converter rather than being taken as Aralo templates. A file newer than the build understands is refused rather than half read.

name.description: The exported library's name, from its `aralo.yaml`. Absent when the library has none.

snippets.description: The snippets, in library path order, so two exports of an unchanged library are the same file.

snippet.description: One snippet: its front matter (docs/format/snippet.md) plus the group path that says which folder it belongs in. Every key is optional; a snippet with neither a body nor an abbreviation is skipped on import.

id.description: The snippet's identity, kept across an export and an import so a round trip does not create duplicates. Absent when the snippet's file had no id yet: exporting one would invent an identity, so the import mints a new one instead.

label.description: Human-readable name. Also what an import builds the file name from.

abbr.description: The abbreviations that expand this snippet. A single string is accepted on read. In the CSV, several abbreviations share one cell, separated by line breaks.

group.description: Folder names from the library root down to the snippet's group. `"Work/Email"` is accepted on read and means the same as `["Work", "Email"]`. Empty means the root of the library.

tags.description: Free-form tags. A single string is accepted on read.

type.description: What kind of snippet this is. Default: `text`.

trigger.description: Absent: the snippet's file said nothing and the group decides. An export does not carry `_group.yaml`, so a snippet that inherited a setting arrives without it.

keep_delimiter.description: Re-insert the delimiter that triggered the expansion. Absent: inherited; see `trigger`.

enabled.description: `false` switches this snippet off. Absent: enabled.

body.description: The template text, with Aralo placeholders (docs/format/placeholders.md). In a document with no `format` key this is whatever the other tool wrote, and the import converts it.

ulid.description: A ULID: 26 characters of Crockford base32 (digits and letters without I, L, O and U).
